extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and editors trying to find or create an article (here: about a person named Mike DiCenzo)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for locating or creating a Wikipedia article for an individual (finding alternative pages, account/creation requirements, redirects, deletion checks, and using the article wizard).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement for creating new articles
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create an article directly, use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article as an alternative
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an alternative path when you are not able to create a live article (e.g., not autoconfirmed) or prefer draft-review workflow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for alternative titles or spellings before creating a page
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for 'Mike DiCenzo' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect to the correct title if appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages that link to the target title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding inbound links can help locate existing coverage of the subject under a different title or reveal where a redirect may be appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account for recent-creation visibility delays and use purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you expect a newly created page to exist but cannot see it, either wait briefly for replication or perform a page purge to force an update.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if the page may have been removed
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewing deletion log entries and explanatory pages can reveal why an article was removed (e.g., notability issues, copyright, vandalism) and guide remediation or re-creation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for the subject on Wikipedia sister projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for Mike DiCenzo on one of Wikipedia's sister projects: Wiktionary, Wikibooks, Wikiquote, Wikisource, Wikiversity, Commons, Wikivoyage, Wikinews, Wikidata, Wikispecies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relevant material about the subject may exist on sister projects (e.g., media on Commons, structured data on Wikidata); check those before creating duplicate content on Wikipedia.
